## 1. What is CafeQR?
CafeQR (https://www.cafeqr.in/) is a high-speed Point of Sale (POS), GST billing software, business accounting ERP, and direct online ordering website generator designed for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, food trucks, cloud kitchens, grocery stores, and retail businesses.

It runs seamlessly on any Android smartphone, Android tablet, iPad, Windows PC, or dedicated touch POS terminal, and connects wirelessly to portable 58mm (2-inch) and desktop 80mm (3-inch) Bluetooth/USB thermal receipt printers.

---

## 2. Core Functional Pillars

### A. High-Speed POS & Billing Counter
- **3-Second Checkout:** Designed for high-volume counter sales and dining tables.
- **Dynamic UPI QR Code on Bill:** Prints dynamic or static UPI QR codes (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) directly on thermal paper for rapid contactless payment at the counter or table.
- **GST Compliance:** Automated calculation of CGST, SGST, IGST, with customizable tax slabs, composite schemes, and B2B/B2C GST invoices.
- **Multi-Payment Settlement:** Split bills, Cash tender with automatic change calculation, Credit/Debit cards (EDC machine integration), and Customer Credit (Khata / Udhar).
- **100% Offline Billing Safeguard:** Continue taking orders and printing thermal receipts even without internet. Data automatically syncs to cloud ERP when internet is restored.

### B. Zero-Commission Online Delivery & Takeaway Store Generator
- **Stop Paying 30% Aggregator Commissions:** Instantly creates a branded online food ordering website for direct customer orders.
- **Zero Commission:** 100% of order revenue goes directly to the restaurant owner's bank account.
- **Direct Delivery & Takeaway:** Customers order directly from their phones, choose delivery or self-pickup, and pay via UPI or Cash on Delivery.
- **Integrated Driver Dispatch App:** Dedicated CafeQR Delivery App for driver routing, order tracking, and live status updates.

### C. Digital QR Menu & Table Dine-In Ordering
- **Contactless Table QR Ordering:** Customers scan QR table stands using their smartphone cameras to view visual photo menus, prices, and dietary tags (Veg/Non-Veg, Eggless, Vegan).
- **Self-Ordering:** Diners can place orders directly from their tables, reducing waiter dependency and eliminating order delays during peak rushes.

### D. Multi-Kitchen KOT (Kitchen Order Ticket) Routing
- **Automated KOT Printing:** Orders punched from waiter tablets, cashier counters, or customer QR menus automatically print in the kitchen.
- **Split Station Routing:** Food items automatically route to the kitchen thermal printer, while beverage orders route to the bar or barista printer.
- **Kitchen Display System (KDS):** Digital KOT management on kitchen Android tablets.

### E. Business Accounting, Daily Khata & Expense Management
- **Daily Sales & Petty Cash:** Real-time tracking of daily gross revenue, payment method breakdown (Cash vs. UPI vs. Card), and cash drawer balancing.
- **Customer Ledger (Khata / Udhar):** Maintain digital customer credit records with automated WhatsApp payment reminder links.
- **Expense Tracking:** Log vendor payments, ingredient purchases, staff wages, utilities, and rent to calculate net daily/monthly profit margins.
- **Live Owner Smartphone Dashboard:** Monitor live restaurant sales, top-selling dishes, table occupancy, and inventory from anywhere on iOS or Android.

### F. Inventory, Recipe & Ingredient Stock ERP
- **Recipe Management:** Automatically deducts raw ingredients (e.g. coffee beans, milk, chicken, cheese, flour) when items are billed.
- **Variant Pricing:** Full support for multi-variant items by weight (0.5 kg, 1 kg), size (Small, Medium, Large), or custom beverage modifiers (Oat Milk, Syrups, Sugar level).
- **Low Stock & Expiry Alerts:** Instant alerts before ingredients run out or perishable bakery items expire.

## 5. Why Businesses Choose CafeQR Over Competitors

- **Vs. Petpooja / Posist (Restroworks):** CafeQR does not charge exorbitant annual fees (₹15,000–₹35,000+). CafeQR starts at just ₹2,499/year or ₹4,999 with printer, runs on any Android phone, and includes a free zero-commission delivery website.
- **Vs. Vyapar / Generic Accounting Apps:** Generic billing apps lack restaurant-specific essentials like Kitchen KOT printing, visual table floorplans, recipe ingredient deductions, and QR dine-in ordering.
- **Vs. Swiggy & Zomato:** Aggregators charge 25–35% commission on every order and withhold customer data. CafeQR provides a direct, branded online ordering website with 0% commission where the business keeps 100% profit and customer phone numbers for WhatsApp marketing.
- **Vs. Old Mechanical Billing Machines:** Standalone billing machines have tiny numerical keypads, break frequently, require manual paper Z-reports, and cannot sync to an owner's smartphone. CafeQR provides cloud reports, instant menu changes, and full touch operation.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I run CafeQR on my existing Android smartphone or tablet?
Yes. CafeQR runs smoothly on any Android smartphone, Android tablet, iPad, or Windows touch terminal. You do not need to purchase expensive proprietary POS terminals.

### Which thermal printers are supported?
CafeQR uses universal ESC/POS protocol and supports all standard 58mm (2-inch) and 80mm (3-inch) Bluetooth, USB, WiFi, and Ethernet thermal printers, including brands like Hoin, Shreyans, Everycom, TVS, Epson, Star Micronics, NGX, and POSIFLEX.

### How does the offline billing mode work?
If your internet or WiFi disconnects during busy hours, CafeQR continues to punch orders, calculate totals, and print thermal receipts without interruption. As soon as connectivity returns, all sales, payments, and inventory adjustments automatically synchronize to the cloud ERP.

### Can customers pay directly using UPI QR codes?
Yes. CafeQR can print dynamic UPI QR codes directly on the thermal bill or show them on the cashier screen. Customers scan using Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or BHIM for immediate payment.

### How do I get started with a live demo?
Business owners can connect directly on WhatsApp at **+91 7012120844** (https://wa.me/917012120844) to get a free 5-minute interactive live demo. The CafeQR support team sets up your full menu and tax details for free within 30 minutes.
